_help: Raid bosses added by hand, for anything the automatic sources miss. 'key' is the Pokémon's id in data/game.json (e.g. MEWTWO, MAROWAK_ALOLA, CHARIZARD_MEGA_X). 'tier' is one of 1, 3, 5, elite, mega, mega_legendary, primal, super_mega_4, super_mega_5, shadow_1, shadow_3, shadow_5. Optional: 'status' (past, current, upcoming; default past) and 'shields' (Super Mega raids). Run `npm run build:data` after editing.
_sources: Super Mega shield counts: in-game lobby counts reported by poketory.com and Pokebattler raid guides.
